Method of Attack: Injecting malicious JavaScript skimming code into ecommerce checkout or cart pages to steal credit card and address information
Compromising a third-party advertising script from Adverline to inject MageCart skimmer into hundreds of ecommerce sites simultaneously
Using fingerprinting to evade detection by security researchers and automated scanners
Loading skimmer script only on targeted URLs containing keywords related to checkout and payment
Exfiltrating stolen data via URL-encoded POST requests with base64 encoded payloads
Impacted Systems: 277 ecommerce websites providing ticketing, touring, and flight booking services
Self-hosted shopping cart websites from prominent cosmetic, healthcare, and apparel brands
Large sites previously affected by MageCart attacks such as British Airways, TicketMaster, OXO, and Newegg
Attack Vector: Compromised third-party advertising script from French online advertiser Adverline
Injection of malicious JavaScript into customer websites via the compromised Adverline script
